email.body1:
Tally, saw Stampli shipped Deep Finance, turning invoice data into consultant-grade analysis in minutes.

A launch like that usually drives more inbound and target accounts than the SDR team can follow up on fast enough, and response speed is where meetings get won or lost. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so your reps cover more without ramping new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to a few of Stampli's top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Tally, quick follow-up for Stampli.

With a new product driving volume, the bottleneck for most SDR teams is follow-up speed and ramp time, not lead count. Reps lose hours on research and writing instead of conversations.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and where your team is leaking responses. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Tally, last bit of proof for Stampli.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Stampli's reply rate likely compares to other fintech teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tally, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up without adding SDRs is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a product launch keeps the whole team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to Stampli either way.
